hero.title: How much is your property worth?
hero.subtitle: Get an accurate estimate in 2 minutes, based on AI analysis of thousands of Swiss real estate transactions.

0.title: Market data
0.description: Analysis of actual sale prices in your municipality and neighborhood.

1.title: 47,000+ transactions
1.description: Database powered by the Swiss Real Estate Datapool and land registries.

2.title: Predictive AI
2.description: Algorithm trained on the specifics of the Swiss real estate market — canton by canton.

3.title: Quarterly updates
3.description: Data recalibrated each quarter to reflect current market trends.

priceTable.title: Average prices per m² in Switzerland

0.a: Our algorithm analyzes recent transactions in your municipality (up to 47,000 sales), living area, number of rooms, year of construction, property condition, and 50 location-related criteria (transport, schools, shops, air quality) to generate a price range.

1.a: The online estimate provides a reliable indicative range for standard properties. For atypical properties (luxury, historic, building land), we recommend an on-site evaluation by a certified agent to refine the result.

2.a: Yes, 100% free with no obligation. You are under no obligation to sell or contact an agent after receiving your estimate.

3.q: What types of properties can I estimate?
3.a: Apartments, houses, villas, building land, and commercial premises throughout Switzerland (26 cantons).

4.q: How can I get a more accurate estimate?
4.a: After the online estimate, you can request a free on-site evaluation by a certified MEGGA agent. The agent will inspect the property, analyze local comparables, and prepare a complete market analysis report.

5.q: How often is the data updated?
5.a: Our models are recalibrated each quarter based on the latest recorded transactions and current listings on the Swiss market.

6.q: Can I estimate a property for a purchase?
6.a: Absolutely. The tool is used both by sellers who want to know their property value and by buyers who want to check if the asking price matches market reality.

0.quote: The integrated CRM changed my daily routine. No more juggling between HubSpot and Excel. And the seller portal consistently impresses my clients.

1.quote: Multi-channel publishing saves me 2 hours per listing. The AI estimation helps me frame seller expectations from the very first meeting.

2.quote: With my international clientele, integrated LAB/KYC compliance is essential. The file is clean, auditable, and it reassures everyone.

0.a: Yes. The Starter plan is 100% free, with no time limit and no credit card. You can manage up to 5 active properties and access basic CRM, AI search, and seller portal.

1.a: MEGGA automatically generates a structured KYC file for each transaction: client identification, risk classification, regulatory checklist and document upload. Each validation requires human action (human-in-the-loop) and a complete audit trail is maintained.

2.q: Is my data hosted in Switzerland?
2.a: Our databases are hosted on servers compliant with Swiss data protection requirements. We use Supabase with encryption at rest and in transit.

3.q: Can I migrate from another CRM?
3.a: Yes. MEGGA supports CSV import for your contacts, properties and transactions. Our team can also assist you with a migration from HubSpot, Salesforce or any other tool.

4.q: What is the difference between Pro and Agency?
4.a: The Pro plan is designed for independent agents (up to 25 properties). The Agency plan adds multi-user, custom branding, API integrations, a dedicated account manager and unlimited properties.

5.q: How does the AI estimation work?
5.a: Our model analyzes over 47,000 Swiss real estate transactions and 70 criteria (location, area, floor, condition, transport proximity, etc.) to produce a real-time price range. The estimate is indicative and does not replace an official appraisal.

6.q: Can I change plans at any time?
6.a: Yes, you can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time from your account settings. The change takes effect immediately with a pro-rata on the current period.

7.a: Publishing on MEGGA is included in all plans. Distribution on ImmoScout24 and Homegate is available from the Pro plan. Your listings are automatically synchronized: a change on MEGGA is reflected on all portals.
